title: Manifest declares 4000 ticks but file content ends at tick 1994
detail: Hunk header (4007 lines) and 'ticks 4000' imply 4000 hash entries; the diff shows only 1994 (header+ticks = 2001 lines). A reader parsing 4000 entries hits EOF at 1995.
recommended_fix: Regenerate or complete the golden file so tick lines reach 4000, or correct the manifest's ticks count to 1994.

title: Hunk header placed before file metadata lines — nonstandard diff ordering
evidence:
diff --git a/goldens/surge.t1 b/goldens/surge.t1
@@ -0,0 +1,4007 @@
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c2c715d
detail: Standard git diff emits the @@ hunk header after ---/+++/index lines; here it precedes them. Indicates the 'canonical' diff was post-processed or reordered by the chunking tool.
recommended_fix: Preserve original git diff line ordering when splitting chunks; verify the splitter does not reorder headers.
